tutorial_spawn.name: Tutorial Path
tutorial_spawn.description: A quiet grassy path just outside Havenbrook's main square. A wooden sign points north toward town, and a few starter supplies have been left here for new adventurers.

village_square.name: Havenbrook Village Square
village_square.description: The heart of Havenbrook village. A beautiful stone fountain bubbles in the center of the cobblestone square. Colorful market stalls line the edges, and villagers bustle about their daily business. Roads lead in all directions - north toward the mountains, south to the coast, east to the farmlands, and west into the deep forests.

village_tavern.name: The Golden Tankard
village_tavern.description: A warm and inviting tavern filled with the smell of roasted meat and fresh ale. A roaring fireplace crackles in the corner. Wooden tables are scattered about, some occupied by locals sharing stories and drinks.

village_shop.name: Harwin's General Store
village_shop.description: A well-organized shop with shelves stacked with supplies, tools, and adventuring gear. The shopkeeper watches you from behind a worn wooden counter.

village_blacksmith.name: Tormund's Forge
village_blacksmith.description: Heat radiates from the massive forge at the center of the smithy. Weapons and armor line the walls, and the ring of hammer on anvil fills the air. Tormund, a burly man with soot-covered arms, works tirelessly.

village_east_end.name: Village East End
village_east_end.description: The eastern edge of Havenbrook. Modest wooden houses line the street, with small gardens behind each. The village chapel stands nearby, its bell tower visible above the rooftops. One house at the end of the row has an unusually plain, featureless wall — no windows, no decoration, nothing.

chapel.name: Chapel of the Light
chapel.description: A peaceful stone chapel with stained glass windows depicting scenes of hope and salvation. Candles flicker on the altar, and the soft scent of incense fills the air. Father Aldric tends to the faithful here. Ancient bookshelves line one wall, filled with theological texts and dusty tomes.

village_clocktower.name: Old Clocktower
village_clocktower.description: A tall stone clocktower that has stood in Havenbrook for over a thousand years. The enormous clockface dominates the exterior, its hands still moving with mechanical precision. Brass gears and cogs are visible through a grate at the base. The door appears to be sealed — but the gears might offer a way in.

village_void_rift.name: Void Rift Overlook
village_void_rift.description: A secluded spot at the edge of Havenbrook where reality flickers. A shimmering tear in the air pulses with violet light — a rift to somewhere else. Local scholars debate whether it is a natural phenomenon or something far more intentional. The rift seems to respond to observation.

underground_archive.name: [HIDDEN] The Underground Archive
underground_archive.description: A vast underground library hidden beneath the chapel, accessible only through a secret passage behind the bookshelves. Ancient stone walls hold thousands of preserved tomes and scrolls, lit by magical lanterns that have burned without fuel for centuries. A sense of profound stillness fills the air — this place has waited a very long time.

pirate_vault.name: [HIDDEN] The Pirate Vault
pirate_vault.description: A hidden vault carved into the sea cave wall, sealed for two centuries. The walls are hung with old pirate flags, navigational charts to unknown islands, and trophies from a hundred voyages. A massive iron chest dominates the centre. Everything smells of salt, rum, and old secrets.

forgotten_shrine_puzzle.name: [HIDDEN] The Forgotten Shrine
forgotten_shrine_puzzle.description: A sacred inner chamber revealed when the altar's three riddles are answered correctly. The chamber glows with soft golden light from crystals embedded in the walls. At the centre, a floating orb pulses with ancient magical energy. Inscriptions on the walls describe the one who placed these treasures here — a hero whose name was deliberately erased from all records.

hidden_alchemy_lab.name: [HIDDEN] The Hidden Alchemy Lab
hidden_alchemy_lab.description: A secret laboratory behind the locked cabinet in the castle library. Gleaming equipment lines every surface — alchemical apparatus, ingredient racks, and journals filled with advanced formulae. The dragonscale armour rests on a stand in the corner, left here by an alchemist who apparently had more pressing concerns than retrieving their best work.

void_sanctuary.name: [HIDDEN] The Void Sanctuary
void_sanctuary.description: A pocket dimension contained within the rift. The floor is polished obsidian that reflects an inverted starscape. The walls do not exist — looking sideways, you see only an infinite dark expanse with distant lights that might be stars or might be something else entirely. Powerful items left here by beings that no longer required physical possessions.

clocktower_interior.name: [HIDDEN] Clocktower Interior
clocktower_interior.description: The impossible interior of the clocktower, accessible through the gear mechanism. Enormous brass gears fill the space, turning with stately precision. The whole structure vibrates subtly at the resonant frequency of time itself. Halfway up, on a platform you should not be able to reach, someone has left treasures that have been waiting here for a millennium.

developers_corner.name: [HIDDEN] The Developer's Corner
developers_corner.description: A small room that has no business existing. The walls are covered in diagrams, flowcharts, and design documents for what is obviously the world you have been walking through. A plain desk holds a laptop, several empty cups, and a notebook labelled 'PHASE 4 IDEAS (DO NOT READ)'. A figure sits at the desk with the expression of someone who did not expect company.

village_west_end.name: Village West End
village_west_end.description: The western part of Havenbrook where the village meets the wilderness. The road here turns to dirt and leads into the shadowy Elderwood Forest. A few hardy souls have built their homes on this frontier edge.

village_north_gate.name: Havenbrook North Gate
village_north_gate.description: A sturdy wooden gate marks the northern entrance to Havenbrook. Beyond it, a winding road climbs toward the distant Stormspire Mountains. Guards occasionally patrol here, watching for trouble from the highlands.

village_south_road.name: Southern Village Road
village_south_road.description: The cobblestones give way to packed earth as the road leads south from the village. You can smell salt on the breeze - the Azure Coast lies that way. Merchants often travel this route to Port Haven.

village_gardens.name: Village Gardens
village_gardens.description: A peaceful garden area where villagers grow herbs and flowers. Bees buzz among the blossoms, and a small bench offers a place to rest and enjoy the scenery.

village_pond.name: Village Pond
village_pond.description: A tranquil pond at the edge of the village where ducks paddle lazily. Children sometimes come here to fish with makeshift poles. Lily pads dot the surface.

village_training_grounds.name: Training Grounds
village_training_grounds.description: An open area where the village militia practices combat. Training dummies stand in rows, and weapon racks line the perimeter. The ground is worn from countless drills.

stables.name: Village Stables
stables.description: A large wooden stable housing horses and pack animals. The smell of hay and animals is strong. A stable hand tends to the creatures with care.

orchard.name: Apple Orchard
orchard.description: Rows of apple trees stretch across this hillside orchard. In season, the branches hang heavy with fruit. A weathered ladder leans against one of the larger trees.

farmland_west.name: Western Farmlands
farmland_west.description: Golden fields of wheat sway in the breeze. Farmhouses dot the landscape, and the distant sound of roosters carries on the wind. This is the breadbasket of Havenbrook.

farmland_center.name: Central Farmlands
farmland_center.description: The heart of the farming district. A large barn stands nearby, and scarecrows guard the fields against crows. Farmers work the land with dedication.

farmland_east.name: Eastern Farmlands
farmland_east.description: The farmland gives way to rolling hills here. You can see the desert wastes shimmering in the distant east. A lonely windmill creaks in the breeze.

farmland_north.name: Northern Farmlands
farmland_north.description: Sheep graze on the gentle slopes here. Stone walls divide the pastures. The road north leads toward the mountains.

farmland_south.name: Southern Farmlands
farmland_south.description: The fields here grow vegetables and herbs. A small stream provides irrigation. The road continues south toward the coast.

shepherd_cottage.name: Shepherd's Cottage
shepherd_cottage.description: A humble stone cottage where a shepherd lives with their flock. Wool blankets hang on a line to dry. A friendly dog watches over the sheep.

old_battlefield.name: Old Battlefield
old_battlefield.description: A somber field where an ancient battle was fought. Rusted weapons and scattered bones still emerge from the earth after heavy rains. A weathered monument honors the fallen.

windmill_hill.name: Windmill Hill
windmill_hill.description: A tall stone windmill stands atop this hill, its great sails turning slowly in the wind. The miller grinds grain here for the whole region. You can see for miles in every direction.

forest_edge.name: Edge of Elderwood
forest_edge.description: The trees of Elderwood Forest rise before you like a green wall. Sunlight barely penetrates the canopy ahead. This ancient forest is said to hide many secrets... and dangers.

forest_path.name: Forest Path
forest_path.description: A winding path through the dense forest. Birds chirp overhead and small animals rustle in the undergrowth. The trees seem to press in from all sides.

forest_clearing.name: Sunny Clearing
forest_clearing.description: A beautiful clearing where sunlight streams through a gap in the canopy. Wildflowers carpet the ground, and butterflies dance on the breeze. A moment of peace in the wild forest.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.description: The forest grows darker here. Ancient trees tower above, their branches blocking most of the sunlight. The air is cool and damp. Strange sounds echo from deeper within.

mossy_hollow.name: Mossy Hollow
mossy_hollow.description: A damp depression where soft emerald moss covers everything. Fallen logs create natural seats. Fireflies drift lazily between ferns even during the day.

forest_grove.name: Tranquil Grove
forest_grove.description: A peaceful grove where birds sing sweetly. Ancient oaks form a natural cathedral. This place feels sacred, untouched by the troubles of the outside world.

woodland_shrine.name: Woodland Shrine
woodland_shrine.description: Stone monoliths draped in ivy mark an ancient place of worship. Offerings of wilted flowers and small coins are scattered at the base of a moss-covered altar. The air hums with faint energy. The altar bears three faded inscriptions — questions, perhaps, left by the shrine's original builders.

hermit_cabin.name: Hermit's Cabin
hermit_cabin.description: A rough-hewn log cabin in a small clearing. Smoke curls from a stone chimney. Herbs and animal pelts dry on a line. Old Finn, the forest hermit, watches you from the doorway with knowing eyes.

ancient_grove.name: Ancient Grove
ancient_grove.description: Massive, impossibly old trees form a living cathedral. Shafts of golden light pierce the canopy. This place feels sacred and timeless. A strange energy pulses from between the roots of the largest tree.

enter.transition_text: The ancient roots part before you, revealing a passage into the living depths beneath the World Tree...

dungeon_forest_entrance.name: Crystal Cave Entrance
dungeon_forest_entrance.description: A foreboding cave mouth opens in a moss-covered hillside. Strange energy pulses from within, and faint crystalline lights glimmer in the darkness. Ancient runes are carved into the stone archway.

enter.transition_text: You step into the shimmering cave mouth. Crystal formations catch and scatter the light as you descend into the depths...

forest_pool.name: Forest Pool
forest_pool.description: A clear pool fed by a small waterfall. The water is cold and refreshing. Fish dart beneath the surface, and ferns grow thick around the edges.

forest_south_edge.name: Southern Forest Edge
forest_south_edge.description: The forest thins here, transitioning to wetlands to the south. The ground becomes softer and wetter. Mist curls between the trees.

swamp_trail.name: Swamp Trail
swamp_trail.description: A treacherous trail winds through the misty Shadowmire Swamp. The ground squelches underfoot, and the air reeks of decay. Gnarled trees draped in moss loom overhead.

meadow.name: Misty Meadow
meadow.description: A low-lying meadow where mist clings to the ground. The grass is damp and thick. This area marks the boundary between the swamp and more hospitable lands.

foggy_marsh.name: Foggy Marsh
foggy_marsh.description: Thick fog obscures your vision. You can barely see a few feet ahead. The ground is waterlogged, and strange sounds echo through the mist. Something moves in the murky water.

swamp_edge.name: Swamp Edge
swamp_edge.description: The western edge of the swamp. The ground rises slightly here, becoming more solid. Dead trees stand like skeletal sentinels. A foul smell drifts from the east.

forest_swamp_border.name: Forest-Swamp Border
forest_swamp_border.description: Where the forest meets the swamp. Trees thin out and become twisted. The ground transitions from firm soil to soggy muck. An uneasy feeling pervades this place.

witch_hut.name: Witch's Hut
witch_hut.description: A decrepit hut on stilts rises from the murk. Skulls and strange charms hang from the eaves. Smoke rises from a crooked chimney. Old Martha, the swamp witch, watches you with rheumy eyes.

deep_swamp.name: Deep Swamp
deep_swamp.description: The heart of Shadowmire, where few dare to tread. The water is waist-deep in places, murky and foul. Strange lights flicker in the distance - will-o'-wisps leading the unwary to their doom.

sunken_ruins.name: Sunken Ruins
sunken_ruins.description: The remains of an ancient civilization, half-submerged in the swamp. Crumbling stone walls and collapsed archways hint at former grandeur. What secrets lie beneath the murky water?

graveyard_gates.name: Graveyard Gates
graveyard_gates.description: Rusted iron gates mark the entrance to an ancient, overgrown graveyard. The fog is especially thick here, and the silence is oppressive. Tombstones lean at odd angles beyond the gate.

graveyard_road.name: Graveyard Road
graveyard_road.description: A gloomy road leading to the old graveyard. Dead trees line the path, their branches reaching like skeletal fingers. Few travel this way willingly.

graveyard.name: Overgrown Graveyard
graveyard.description: Row upon row of ancient tombstones, many cracked or toppled. Weeds and thorns have overrun the graves. The mausoleums at the far end look particularly foreboding. The dead do not rest easy here.

open_crypt.name: Open Crypt
open_crypt.description: The door to this ancient crypt hangs open. Stone steps descend into darkness. A cold wind blows up from below, carrying whispers of the dead. Something powerful lurks in the depths.

enter.transition_text: You descend the cold stone steps. The whispers grow louder, and shadows seem to move with malevolent purpose...

crossroads.name: Lonely Crossroads
crossroads.description: Four roads meet at this windswept crossroads. A weathered signpost points in each direction: North to the Mountains, South to the Coast, East to the Desert, West to the Swamp. Travelers sometimes camp here.

northern_road.name: Northern Road
northern_road.description: A well-traveled road leading north from Havenbrook toward the Stormspire Mountains. The ground begins to rise, and the air grows cooler. Snow-capped peaks are visible in the distance.

eastern_road.name: Eastern Road
eastern_road.description: A dusty road leading east toward the Sunscorch Desert. The vegetation grows sparse, and the air dry. Heat shimmers on the horizon.

dusty_crossroads.name: Dusty Crossroads
dusty_crossroads.description: Where the eastern road meets paths from the coast and desert. The ground is parched and cracked. A lonely water well offers respite to travelers.

highland_road.name: Highland Road
highland_road.description: The road climbs through rocky highlands. Hardy shrubs and heather dot the landscape. The wind is stronger here, carrying the scent of snow from the peaks above.

mountain_foothills.name: Mountain Foothills
mountain_foothills.description: The terrain rises sharply here at the base of the Stormspire Mountains. Rocky outcroppings jut from the hillside, and mountain goats graze on the slopes. The main peak towers above.

mountain_stream.name: Mountain Stream
mountain_stream.description: A crystal-clear stream rushes down from the mountains. The water is ice-cold and pure. Fish dart through the shallows, and the sound of the water is soothing.

waterfall_base.name: Waterfall Basin
waterfall_base.description: A magnificent waterfall cascades down the cliff face into a deep pool. Mist fills the air, creating rainbows in the sunlight. The roar of the water is deafening.

mountain_path.name: Mountain Path
mountain_path.description: A treacherous path winds up the mountainside. Loose rocks make footing dangerous. The higher you go, the colder it gets. Snow begins to appear on the ground.

rocky_valley.name: Rocky Valley
rocky_valley.description: A valley strewn with boulders and rocky debris. Old mining equipment lies abandoned - perhaps from failed prospecting attempts. A cave opening is visible in the cliff face.

dungeon_mountain_entrance.name: Ancient Mountain Gate
dungeon_mountain_entrance.description: Massive stone doors carved with dwarven runes mark the entrance to the legendary Iron Halls. The craftsmanship is ancient but still magnificent. Strange sounds echo from within.

enter.transition_text: The great stone doors grind open. You step into halls that have stood for millennia, lit by an eternal forge-glow...

highland_pass.name: Highland Pass
highland_pass.description: A narrow pass between two peaks. The wind howls through the gap. Snow drifts against the rocks. This is the main route to the frozen north.

high_pass.name: High Mountain Pass
high_pass.description: Near the top of the mountain range. The air is thin and bitterly cold. Ice clings to the rocks, and snow covers everything. The path ahead leads to the peak itself.

mountain_peak.name: Stormspire Summit
mountain_peak.description: The highest point in the realm. You stand above the clouds, with an endless vista spread before you. A frozen spire of ice rises nearby, its surface etched with ancient magic. This is the entrance to the Frozen Spire.

enter.transition_text: You touch the frozen spire and reality fractures. You step through into a realm of eternal ice and ancient power...

eastern_highlands.name: Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.description: The eastern slopes of the mountains, where the terrain transitions to drier lands. The vegetation is sparse, adapted to the harsh climate. Far below, the desert shimmers.

frozen_approach.name: Frozen Approach
frozen_approach.description: Beyond the mountain peak lies a frozen wilderness. Eternal snow covers the ground, and the wind cuts like knives. Few venture this far north and return.

tundra_edge.name: Tundra Edge
tundra_edge.description: The beginning of the endless tundra. Nothing but snow and ice stretches to the horizon. The cold is intense, sapping your strength with every step.

frozen_lake.name: Frozen Lake
frozen_lake.description: A vast lake frozen solid. The ice is thick enough to walk on, but cracks and groans ominously. Dark shapes can be seen frozen beneath the surface.

ice_fields.name: Ice Fields
ice_fields.description: Jagged ice formations rise from the frozen ground. The wind has carved the ice into bizarre, beautiful shapes. The cold here is deadly - you cannot stay long.

ice_caves_entrance.name: Ice Caves Entrance
ice_caves_entrance.description: The entrance to a network of ice caves. Blue light filters through the frozen walls. The caves offer shelter from the wind, but strange creatures are said to lurk within.

frozen_outpost.name: Abandoned Outpost
frozen_outpost.description: The ruins of a research outpost, abandoned long ago. Frozen supplies and equipment lie scattered about. Whatever happened here, it was sudden.

kingshold_approach.name: Approach to Kingshold
kingshold_approach.description: A grand road paved with white stone leads to the magnificent Kingshold Castle. Banners flutter from distant towers. This is the seat of royal power in the realm.

castle_gates.name: Castle Gates
castle_gates.description: Massive iron-bound gates stand before you, flanked by towers manned by vigilant guards. The royal banner - a golden crown on blue - flies overhead. Visitors must state their business.

castle_courtyard.name: Castle Courtyard
castle_courtyard.description: A spacious courtyard within the castle walls. Knights train in one corner, servants hurry about their duties, and nobles stroll in fine clothes. The castle keep rises impressively ahead.

castle_hall.name: Castle Great Hall
castle_hall.description: A magnificent hall with vaulted ceilings and stained glass windows. Tapestries depicting the realm's history line the walls. At the far end sits the empty throne - the king is often away on matters of state.

castle_tower.name: Castle Tower
castle_tower.description: A high tower offering a commanding view of the surrounding lands. Maps and telescopes are arranged near the windows. From here, you can see across the entire realm.

castle_barracks.name: Castle Barracks
castle_barracks.description: Housing for the castle guard. Bunk beds line the walls, and weapon racks hold an impressive array of arms. Soldiers rest between patrols.

royal_garden.name: Royal Garden
royal_garden.description: An exquisite garden with manicured hedges, flowering bushes, and marble statues. A fountain tinkles pleasantly in the center. This is a place of beauty and contemplation.

desert_border.name: Desert Border
desert_border.description: The last of the grass gives way to sand and rock. Before you stretches the Sunscorch Desert, a vast expanse of dunes and deadly heat. Only the foolish or desperate venture further unprepared.

desert_cliffs.name: Desert Cliffs
desert_cliffs.description: Red sandstone cliffs rise sharply from the desert floor. Caves and overhangs offer some shade. Ancient drawings are etched into the rock face.

canyon_entrance.name: Canyon Entrance
canyon_entrance.description: The entrance to a deep canyon carved by an ancient river long since dried up. The walls tower above you, providing blessed shade. The passage winds deeper into the badlands.

canyon_depths.name: Canyon Depths
canyon_depths.description: Deep within the canyon. Strange rock formations cast bizarre shadows. The silence is oppressive, broken only by the wind whistling through the narrows.

desert_dunes_west.name: Western Dunes
desert_dunes_west.description: Endless sand dunes stretch before you. The sun beats down mercilessly. Navigation is difficult - one dune looks much like another. Tracks in the sand are quickly erased by the wind.

desert_dunes_center.name: Central Dunes
desert_dunes_center.description: The heart of the Sunscorch Desert. The dunes here are massive, some rising hundreds of feet. The heat is almost unbearable. Mirages shimmer on the horizon.

hidden_oasis.name: Hidden Oasis
hidden_oasis.description: A miraculous oasis hidden among the dunes. Palm trees provide shade, and a crystal-clear pool offers cool water. A few resilient plants grow here. This is a lifesaver in the deadly desert.

scorpion_flats.name: Scorpion Flats
scorpion_flats.description: A rocky, flat area infested with scorpions. Their burrows dot the sandy ground. One must tread carefully here - the creatures are aggressive and venomous.

mesa_base.name: Mesa Base
mesa_base.description: A massive flat-topped mesa rises from the desert. The climb looks treacherous but possible. From the top, one could see for miles. Ancient trails wind up the sides.

mesa_top.name: Mesa Summit
mesa_top.description: The top of the great mesa. The view is breathtaking - you can see the entire desert, the distant mountains, and even a glint of the sea to the south. Old ruins are half-buried in sand here.

oasis_village.name: Oasis Village of Al-Zahir
oasis_village.description: A small but thriving village built around a large oasis. Adobe buildings provide shelter from the sun. The locals are friendly but wary of outsiders. Traders pass through regularly.

desert_ruins.name: Desert Ruins
desert_ruins.description: The remains of an ancient civilization, half-swallowed by the sands. Crumbling pillars and broken statues hint at former glory. Treasures - and dangers - await those who explore.

sandstone_fortress.name: Sandstone Fortress
sandstone_fortress.description: A crumbling fortress of sandstone, once a mighty stronghold, now home to bandits and desert creatures. The walls still stand, offering shelter from sandstorms.

coastal_road_north.name: Northern Coastal Road
coastal_road_north.description: A sandy road leading south toward the Azure Coast. You can smell the salt on the breeze and hear the distant cry of seagulls. The road is well-traveled by merchants.

coastal_cliffs.name: Coastal Cliffs
coastal_cliffs.description: Dramatic cliffs overlook the sparkling Azure Coast. The waves crash against the rocks far below. A winding path descends to the beaches. Seabirds wheel overhead.

lighthouse_hill.name: Lighthouse Hill
lighthouse_hill.description: A tall white lighthouse stands on this promontory, its light guiding ships safely into harbor. The keeper maintains it diligently. The view of the coast is spectacular.

sandy_beach.name: Sandy Beach
sandy_beach.description: A beautiful stretch of golden sand. Waves lap gently at the shore. Shells and driftwood are scattered about. Children play in the surf while fishermen mend their nets.

tidal_caves.name: Tidal Caves
tidal_caves.description: Sea caves carved by millennia of waves. At low tide, you can explore the shallow caves. Tide pools teem with colorful marine life. Locals gather shellfish here.

rocky_shore.name: Rocky Shore
rocky_shore.description: A stretch of coast dominated by large boulders and rocky outcroppings. The surf crashes violently against the rocks. Crabs scuttle between the tide pools.

reef_shallows.name: Reef Shallows
reef_shallows.description: Clear, shallow water over a coral reef. The water is warm and teeming with colorful fish. Pieces of coral and shells can be gathered here. The reef protects a small cove.

smugglers_cove.name: Smuggler's Cove
smugglers_cove.description: A hidden cove accessible only by a narrow passage. Evidence of illegal activity is everywhere - crates, ropes, and hidden paths. The authorities rarely find this place.

port_haven_north.name: Port Haven - North District
port_haven_north.description: The northern part of Port Haven, the largest coastal settlement. Ships' masts are visible over the rooftops. The smell of fish and salt fills the air. Sailors and merchants bustle about.

port_haven_market.name: Port Haven Market
port_haven_market.description: A bustling marketplace where goods from across the seas are traded. Exotic spices, foreign silks, and strange artifacts catch your eye. Haggling is expected.

harbor_inn.name: The Salty Sailor Inn
harbor_inn.description: A rowdy inn frequented by sailors and travelers. Sea chanties fill the air, and the ale flows freely. Rooms can be rented upstairs. Stories of adventure are shared over drinks.

port_haven_docks.name: Port Haven Docks
port_haven_docks.description: The busy docks of Port Haven. Ships from distant lands are moored here, loading and unloading cargo. The creak of wood and shout of sailors creates a constant din. A well-maintained road leads south toward the Grand Harbor.

old_pier.name: Old Pier
old_pier.description: A weathered wooden pier extending into the sea. Fishermen cast their lines here. The boards creak underfoot. At the end, you can see the ancient sea ruins in the distance.

dungeon_ruins_entrance.name: Sunken Catacombs Entrance
dungeon_ruins_entrance.description: Ancient stone steps descend into the sea. At low tide, the entrance to the Sunken Catacombs is revealed - a flooded tomb complex from a civilization lost to the waves long ago.

enter.transition_text: You descend the algae-slick steps into the flooded darkness. The air is thick with the scent of brine and ancient death...

coastal_road_east.name: Eastern Coastal Road
coastal_road_east.description: A road connecting Port Haven to the eastern desert. The terrain transitions from coastal greenery to arid scrubland. Camel caravans sometimes pass this way.

twilight_woods.name: Twilight Woods
twilight_woods.description: These woods are perpetually dim, even at midday. Strange blue mushrooms grow on the trees, providing an eerie glow. The silence here is unsettling.

dark_hollow.name: Dark Hollow
dark_hollow.description: A depression in the forest floor where light barely reaches. Twisted roots create a maze-like terrain. Something watches from the shadows.

forgotten_shrine.name: Forgotten Shrine
forgotten_shrine.description: An ancient stone shrine covered in moss and vines. Offerings left here long ago have rotted away. The carved face on the altar still watches with empty eyes.

wolf_den.name: Wolf Den
wolf_den.description: A rocky outcropping with caves beneath. Wolf tracks and bones are scattered about. The pack seems to be away, but may return at any moment.

tangled_thicket.name: Tangled Thicket
tangled_thicket.description: Dense undergrowth makes passage difficult. Thorns and briars tear at your clothes. Animal trails crisscross through the vegetation.

old_logging_camp.name: Old Logging Camp
old_logging_camp.description: An abandoned logging camp. Rusted saws and rotten stumps remain. A collapsed cabin offers little shelter. Nature is reclaiming this place.

western_swamp_approach.name: Western Swamp Approach
western_swamp_approach.description: The ground becomes increasingly soggy as the forest gives way to swampland. Mist curls through the trees, and the croaking of frogs fills the air.

fairy_ring.name: Fairy Ring
fairy_ring.description: A perfect circle of mushrooms in a moonlit glade. Legend says fairies dance here at night. The air shimmers with faint magic.

fallen_giant.name: Fallen Giant
fallen_giant.description: A massive ancient tree has fallen here, creating a bridge over a ravine. Moss and fungi cover its enormous trunk. The hollow interior could shelter several people.

ravine_crossing.name: Ravine Crossing
ravine_crossing.description: A rope bridge spans a deep ravine. The boards creak ominously. Far below, a stream glints in the shadows. Brave souls cross quickly.

hunter_camp.name: Hunter's Camp
hunter_camp.description: A small camp used by hunters and trappers. A fire pit is surrounded by log seats. Animal traps hang from nearby branches. Fresh tracks suggest recent use.

goat_trail.name: Goat Trail
goat_trail.description: A narrow trail used by mountain goats winds along the cliff face. One wrong step would be fatal. The view is breathtaking.

eagle_nest.name: Eagle's Nest
eagle_nest.description: A high plateau where eagles nest. Feathers and bones are scattered about. The view of the realm is magnificent. The wind is strong and cold.

mining_tunnels.name: Old Mining Tunnels
mining_tunnels.description: Abandoned mine shafts bore into the mountain. The timbers are rotted and dangerous. Occasional glints suggest valuable ore might still be found.

hermit_peak.name: Hermit's Peak
hermit_peak.description: A secluded peak where a meditation shrine sits. Prayer flags flutter in the wind. Someone has carved steps into the rock face.

avalanche_path.name: Avalanche Path
avalanche_path.description: A path through an area prone to avalanches. Debris from past slides is visible. Snow hangs precariously on the slopes above. Move quickly and quietly.

frozen_stream.name: Frozen Stream
frozen_stream.description: A stream frozen solid. Ice formations hang from the rocks. The surface is slippery but crossable. Fish are visible beneath the clear ice.

dwarf_ruins.name: Dwarven Ruins
dwarf_ruins.description: The crumbling remains of an ancient dwarven outpost. Stone foundations and collapsed walls hint at former glory. Runes are carved into surviving stones.

northern_lookout.name: Northern Lookout
northern_lookout.description: A stone watchtower on a mountain spur. From here, guards once watched for threats from the north. The tower still stands, though abandoned.

bleached_bones.name: Valley of Bones
bleached_bones.description: A valley littered with the bleached bones of countless creatures. Some are enormous, suggesting ancient beasts. The desert has claimed many victims.

sand_sea.name: Sea of Sand
sand_sea.description: An endless expanse of sand dunes that seemingly goes on forever. The wind shifts the sands constantly, erasing all tracks. Navigation is nearly impossible.

mirage_oasis.name: Mirage Oasis
mirage_oasis.description: An oasis that seems to shimmer and shift. Is it real or illusion? Desperate travelers have died chasing mirages. But the water here seems real enough...

serpent_canyon.name: Serpent Canyon
serpent_canyon.description: A winding canyon with walls that twist like a serpent. Sand snakes are common here, lurking in crevices. Ancient pictographs cover the walls.

ancient_pyramid.name: Ancient Pyramid
ancient_pyramid.description: A massive stone pyramid rises from the sands. Once a tomb for ancient rulers, now home to treasure seekers and worse. The entrance yawns darkly.

desert_temple.name: Desert Temple
desert_temple.description: A temple dedicated to the sun god, half-buried in sand. Pillars still stand, casting long shadows. The altar within is said to grant visions.

nomad_camp.name: Nomad Camp
nomad_camp.description: A camp of desert nomads with colorful tents. Camels rest nearby, and the smell of spiced food fills the air. The nomads are wary but not hostile.

dust_storm_plains.name: Dust Storm Plains
dust_storm_plains.description: A flat area where dust storms are common. Visibility can drop to zero without warning. Travelers have been lost for days in these storms.

salt_flats.name: Salt Flats
salt_flats.description: A vast expanse of white salt crusted earth. The sun reflects blindingly off the surface. Nothing grows here, but the salt itself has value.

caravan_waystation.name: Caravan Waystation
caravan_waystation.description: A fortified rest stop for caravans crossing the desert. Wells provide water, and sturdy walls offer protection. Merchants often trade goods here.

blizzard_pass.name: Blizzard Pass
blizzard_pass.description: A treacherous pass where blizzards rage constantly. Snow piles in deep drifts. Only the most determined or foolhardy push through.

frost_giant_territory.name: Frost Giant Territory
frost_giant_territory.description: Land claimed by frost giants. Enormous footprints mark the snow. Ruins of their crude structures dot the landscape. Best to be quiet here.

aurora_viewing.name: Aurora Watching Point
aurora_viewing.description: A clearing perfect for viewing the aurora borealis. The dancing lights paint the sky in greens and purples. Magic seems stronger here.

frozen_waterfall.name: Frozen Waterfall
frozen_waterfall.description: A massive waterfall frozen mid-flow. The ice formations are beautiful, like a sculpture made by nature. Behind the ice, a cave might be hidden.

mammoth_graveyard.name: Mammoth Graveyard
mammoth_graveyard.description: A place where ancient mammoths came to die. Enormous tusks and bones protrude from the snow. A somber, eerie place.

ice_fishing_hole.name: Ice Fishing Hole
ice_fishing_hole.description: A spot where a hole has been cut in the ice for fishing. Someone left equipment behind. Cold work, but the fish here are prized.

shipwreck_beach.name: Shipwreck Beach
shipwreck_beach.description: The skeletal remains of a ship lie on this beach. The hull is broken, and debris is scattered across the sand. What secrets does it hold?

pirates_cove.name: Pirate's Cove
pirates_cove.description: A hidden cove once used by pirates. X marks on rocks hint at buried treasure. The locals avoid this place, but treasure hunters come regularly.

fishing_village.name: Fishing Village
fishing_village.description: A small coastal village where everyone fishes. Nets dry on racks, and the smell of fish is everywhere. Simple folk living simple lives.

coral_reef.name: Coral Reef Shallows
coral_reef.description: Crystal clear water over a vibrant coral reef. Colorful fish dart between the coral formations. The reef extends far into the sea.

tide_pools.name: Tide Pools
tide_pools.description: Pools left behind by the retreating tide. Starfish, anemones, and small crabs can be found. Children love to explore here.

sea_cave.name: Sea Cave
sea_cave.description: A cave accessible only at low tide. The walls are covered in barnacles and sea life. Strange echoes come from deep within. One section of the cave wall looks different — older stonework, deliberately shaped. There are old rope markings carved into the rock.

cliffside_overlook.name: Cliffside Overlook
cliffside_overlook.description: A dramatic viewpoint high above the sea. Seabirds nest on the cliff face below. The sunset view from here is renowned.

kelp_forest.name: Kelp Forest Shallows
kelp_forest.description: A underwater forest of giant kelp in the shallows. The fronds sway with the currents. Many fish hide among the kelp.

corpse_grove.name: Corpse Grove
corpse_grove.description: A grove of dead trees standing in stagnant water. Moss hangs like funeral shrouds. The locals say restless spirits haunt this place.

will_o_wisp_bog.name: Will-o'-Wisp Bog
will_o_wisp_bog.description: Strange lights dance over this treacherous bog. Following them leads only to quicksand. Many have drowned here, lured by the lights.

quicksand_marsh.name: Quicksand Marsh
quicksand_marsh.description: A deceptively solid-looking marsh with hidden quicksand. Test each step carefully. Many an unwary traveler has sunk beneath the surface.

swamp_village.name: Frogmorton Village
swamp_village.description: A village of stilt houses built over the swamp. The locals are reclusive and suspicious of outsiders. They know the swamp's secrets.

crocodile_bog.name: Crocodile Bog
crocodile_bog.description: A stretch of swamp infested with crocodiles. Their eyes watch from the murky water. Crossing requires extreme caution.

giant_lily_pads.name: Giant Lily Pad Crossing
giant_lily_pads.description: Enormous lily pads float on the water here, large enough to stand on. Careful leaping can get you across without swimming.

drowned_temple.name: Drowned Temple
drowned_temple.description: An ancient temple half-submerged in the swamp. Water laps at the entrance. Who knows what lies in the flooded chambers below?

corn_maze.name: Corn Maze
corn_maze.description: Tall corn stalks form a natural maze. In autumn, villagers create paths for festivals. But some say things lurk in the corn year-round.

scarecrow_field.name: Scarecrow Field
scarecrow_field.description: A field guarded by an army of scarecrows. Their blank faces stare eternally. At night, some swear they move...

bee_meadow.name: Bee Meadow
bee_meadow.description: A meadow buzzing with bees. Wildflowers of every color bloom here. The local beekeeper tends hives nearby. The honey is renowned.

old_mill.name: Old Water Mill
old_mill.description: An ancient water mill on a small stream. The wheel still turns, though no one mills grain here anymore. Moss covers the stones.

pasture_lands.name: Pasture Lands
pasture_lands.description: Open grasslands where cattle graze lazily. Stone walls divide the pastures. Occasionally, a cowbell rings in the distance.

covered_bridge.name: Covered Bridge
covered_bridge.description: An old wooden covered bridge spanning a small river. Travelers often rest here. Names and dates are carved into the timbers.

abandoned_farmhouse.name: Abandoned Farmhouse
abandoned_farmhouse.description: A farmhouse abandoned years ago. Windows are broken, doors hang open. Rumor says the family left suddenly, leaving everything behind.

rolling_hills.name: Rolling Hills
rolling_hills.description: Gentle hills covered in grass that waves like the sea. The view stretches for miles. Hawks circle overhead hunting mice.

market_alley.name: Market Alley
market_alley.description: A narrow alley behind the market stalls. Discarded crates and boxes are piled here. Stray cats hunt for scraps.

well_square.name: Well Square
well_square.description: A small square with an old stone well at the center. Women gather here to draw water and exchange gossip. A bucket hangs from a rope.

apothecary.name: Apothecary Shop
apothecary.description: A small shop filled with dried herbs, strange potions, and mysterious ingredients. The elderly apothecary knows remedies for almost any ailment.

village_graveyard.name: Village Graveyard
village_graveyard.description: The village's own small graveyard behind the chapel. Well-tended graves of villagers past. Flowers are often placed on the headstones.

baker_house.name: Baker's House
baker_house.description: The home and shop of the village baker. The smell of fresh bread fills the air. Loaves cool on wooden racks.

village_stream.name: Village Stream
village_stream.description: A clear stream flows past the village. Children play in the shallow water. Some villagers do their washing here.

town_notice_board.name: Town Notice Board
town_notice_board.description: A large wooden board where notices are posted. Job offerings, lost items, and official decrees can be found here. A small crowd often gathers to read.

guild_hall.name: Guild Hall
guild_hall.description: The hall where local guilds meet. Craftsmen display their best work here. Notices for apprenticeships are posted on the door.

winding_path.name: Winding Path
winding_path.description: A path that winds through light woodland. Birds sing in the trees, and wildflowers line the way. A peaceful route between destinations.

trade_road_north.name: Northern Trade Road
trade_road_north.description: A wide road used by merchants traveling to and from the mountains. Wagon ruts are deep in the dirt. Mile markers guide the way.

southern_highway.name: Southern Highway
southern_highway.description: The main road south to Port Haven. Well-maintained and frequently patrolled. Inns are spaced along the route for travelers.

forest_road.name: Forest Road
forest_road.description: A road that skirts the edge of Elderwood Forest. Travelers move quickly here, wary of what might emerge from the trees.

mountain_road.name: Mountain Road
mountain_road.description: A road climbing into the Stormspire Mountains. The grade is steep, and the air grows thinner. Snow appears earlier here than in the lowlands.

haunted_manor.name: Haunted Manor
haunted_manor.description: A decrepit manor on a hill, its windows like dark eyes. Strange lights flicker within at night. The locals avoid this place.

collapsed_tower.name: Collapsed Wizard's Tower
collapsed_tower.description: The ruins of a wizard's tower, collapsed during some magical catastrophe. Strange energies still linger. Broken artifacts are scattered about.

standing_stones.name: Standing Stones
standing_stones.description: A circle of ancient standing stones on a windswept hill. Druids once performed rituals here. The stones hum with residual power.

ruined_shrine.name: Ruined Roadside Shrine
ruined_shrine.description: A small shrine to forgotten gods, now in ruins. Travelers once left offerings here for safe journeys. The statue is weathered beyond recognition.

old_watchtower.name: Old Watchtower
old_watchtower.description: A crumbling watchtower from a long-forgotten war. The stairs are dangerous, but the view from the top is excellent.

bear_cave.name: Bear Cave
bear_cave.description: A large cave that serves as a bear's den. Fresh scratches on the entrance suggest recent activity. Bones and berry remnants litter the floor.

bat_cavern.name: Bat Cavern
bat_cavern.description: A cavern filled with thousands of bats. Their droppings carpet the floor. The sound of their wings is deafening when disturbed.

crystal_grotto.name: Crystal Grotto
crystal_grotto.description: A small cave filled with natural crystal formations. Light refracts beautifully through the crystals, creating rainbows on the walls.

goblin_warren.name: Goblin Warren
goblin_warren.description: A network of small tunnels that once housed goblins. Refuse and crude belongings are scattered about. The goblins seem to have moved on.

spider_nest.name: Spider Nest
spider_nest.description: A cave choked with thick webs. Large spiders lurk in the shadows. Wrapped cocoons hang from the ceiling - some are disturbingly human-sized.

sunset_point.name: Sunset Point
sunset_point.description: A beautiful overlook perfect for watching the sunset. Lovers often come here. Someone has carved a heart into a nearby tree.

meditation_rock.name: Meditation Rock
meditation_rock.description: A large flat rock by a babbling stream. Someone has worn a smooth spot from years of sitting. The atmosphere is peaceful.

picnic_clearing.name: Picnic Clearing
picnic_clearing.description: A lovely clearing where villagers come for picnics. Flat rocks serve as natural tables. Wildflowers bloom in profusion.

fishermans_rest.name: Fisherman's Rest
fishermans_rest.description: A quiet spot by the river where fishermen come to relax. A wooden bench overlooks a deep pool. Fish jump occasionally.

stargazer_hill.name: Stargazer's Hill
stargazer_hill.description: A hill away from village lights, perfect for stargazing. An old astronomer's shack sits at the top, mostly collapsed now.

desert_well.name: Desert Well
desert_well.description: An ancient well in the desert, still providing precious water. Travelers leave offerings of thanks. The stone is worn smooth by countless hands.

vulture_roost.name: Vulture Roost
vulture_roost.description: A rocky outcropping where vultures gather. The birds circle overhead, waiting. A grim reminder of the desert's dangers.

sand_whirlpool.name: Sand Whirlpool
sand_whirlpool.description: A strange phenomenon - a permanent whirlpool in the sand. It's said to be caused by air currents from caves below. Getting too close would be fatal.

ancient_obelisk.name: Ancient Obelisk
ancient_obelisk.description: A tall stone obelisk covered in hieroglyphics. It marks the boundary of an ancient kingdom long since fallen. The writing is indecipherable.

djinn_temple.name: Temple of the Djinn
djinn_temple.description: A temple dedicated to the spirits of the air. Sand constantly swirls around it in patterns that seem almost alive. Strange whispers can be heard.

polar_bear_territory.name: Polar Bear Territory
polar_bear_territory.description: An area frequented by polar bears. Massive paw prints mark the snow. Best to keep moving and stay alert.

seal_colony.name: Seal Colony
seal_colony.description: A stretch of frozen coast where seals gather. They bark and splash in the icy water. The locals come here to hunt, though carefully.

snow_shrine.name: Snow Shrine
snow_shrine.description: A shrine carved entirely from ice. It never melts despite the seasons. Offerings left here freeze instantly. A place of cold magic.

wind_carved_spires.name: Wind-Carved Ice Spires
wind_carved_spires.description: Tall spires of ice sculpted by eternal winds. They sing in the gales, creating an eerie melody. An artist's dream, a traveler's nightmare.

frozen_battlefield.name: Frozen Battlefield
frozen_battlefield.description: An ancient battlefield preserved by the cold. Frozen warriors still stand in combat poses. Their weapons and armor remain, though touching them feels wrong.

pelican_roost.name: Pelican Roost
pelican_roost.description: A rocky area where pelicans nest. The birds are comically awkward on land but graceful in the air. Guano coats everything.

underwater_cave_entrance.name: Underwater Cave Entrance
underwater_cave_entrance.description: At low tide, a cave entrance is revealed. The cave floods at high tide, but treasures and mysteries are said to lie within.

mermaid_rock.name: Mermaid Rock
mermaid_rock.description: A large rock where sailors claim to have seen mermaids. Whether true or just wishful thinking, the rock is a local landmark.

old_lighthouse.name: Old Lighthouse (Ruined)
old_lighthouse.description: An abandoned lighthouse, its light long extinguished. The stairs are dangerous, but explorers still come seeking rumored treasure.

shrimp_boats.name: Shrimp Boat Dock
shrimp_boats.description: A small dock where shrimp boats tie up. Nets hang to dry, and the catch is sorted on the pier. Fresh shrimp can be bought here.

leech_pond.name: Leech Pond
leech_pond.description: A stagnant pond infested with leeches. Crossing requires wading through, and the leeches will find you. Villagers gather them for medicine.

hermit_swamp_shack.name: Swamp Hermit's Shack
hermit_swamp_shack.description: Another hermit's home, this one in the swamp. The owner is even more eccentric than most, speaking to the frogs as if they understand.

ancient_cypress.name: Ancient Cypress
ancient_cypress.description: A massive cypress tree, thousands of years old. Its roots create a maze above the water. Carvings on its trunk suggest it was once sacred.

frog_chorus.name: Frog Chorus Pool
frog_chorus.description: A pool where hundreds of frogs gather. Their evening chorus is deafening. The locals say the frogs predict the weather.

castle_dungeon.name: Castle Dungeon
castle_dungeon.description: The dungeons beneath Kingshold Castle. Thankfully empty of prisoners. Iron shackles hang from the walls, and old straw covers the floor.

castle_library.name: Castle Library
castle_library.description: The royal library, filled with books and scrolls. Knowledge from across the realm is preserved here. Scholars study in quiet alcoves. In the far corner stands an ornate locked cabinet — clearly not part of the standard collection. Alchemical symbols are etched around its frame.

castle_armory.name: Castle Armory
castle_armory.description: The castle's armory, where weapons and armor are stored. Rows of swords, shields, and suits of armor line the walls. Guards patrol regularly.

royal_stables.name: Royal Stables
royal_stables.description: Stables housing the finest horses in the realm. The royal steeds are pampered and well-trained. Grooms tend to them constantly.

castle_chapel.name: Castle Chapel
castle_chapel.description: A beautiful chapel within the castle. Stained glass depicts holy scenes. Royalty have been married and buried here for generations.

mining_village.name: Ironvale Mining Village
mining_village.description: A rough village that grew up around the mountain mines. Miners and their families live in sturdy stone houses. Life is hard but honest here.

logging_settlement.name: Timberfall Settlement
logging_settlement.description: A small settlement of loggers at the forest's edge. The sound of axes and falling trees echoes constantly. Sawdust covers everything.

roadside_inn.name: Crossroads Inn
roadside_inn.description: A welcoming inn at the crossroads. Travelers rest here before continuing their journeys. The innkeeper is friendly and full of gossip.

border_watchtower.name: Border Watchtower
border_watchtower.description: A watchtower marking the border between civilized lands and wilderness. Guards keep watch for bandits and monsters.

ferry_crossing.name: River Ferry Crossing
ferry_crossing.description: A simple ferry crosses a wide river here. The ferryman charges a small fee. The crossing takes several minutes.

bandits_hideout.name: Bandit's Hideout
bandits_hideout.description: A concealed camp used by bandits. Evidence of their crimes is everywhere - stolen goods, weapons, and makeshift barricades.

dragon_bones.name: Dragon Bones
dragon_bones.description: The massive skeleton of an ancient dragon lies half-buried in the hillside. Whether it died of age or battle is unclear. The bones dwarf everything around them.

ancient_battlefield.name: Ancient Battlefield
ancient_battlefield.description: An even older battlefield than the one near the village. Rusted siege weapons and shattered armor litter the ground. The spirits of the fallen are said to walk at night.

meteor_crater.name: Meteor Crater
meteor_crater.description: A massive crater where a meteor fell long ago. Strange metals can be found here. The locals believe the site is cursed - or blessed.

giant_mushroom_grove.name: Giant Mushroom Grove
giant_mushroom_grove.description: A grove where mushrooms grow to enormous size. Some are as tall as trees. The air is thick with spores. Everything here is slightly... wrong.

forgotten_tomb.name: Forgotten Tomb
forgotten_tomb.description: An ancient tomb hidden in the hills. The entrance was recently uncovered by erosion. Treasures and terrors likely await within.

hollow_tree.name: Hollow Tree
hollow_tree.description: An enormous hollow tree that could shelter several people. Someone has lived here - a small fire pit and crude bed remain.

abandoned_mine.name: Abandoned Mine
abandoned_mine.description: An old mine shaft that was abandoned after a collapse. Dangerous, but rumored to still hold valuable ore in its depths.

smugglers_tunnel.name: Smuggler's Tunnel
smugglers_tunnel.description: A secret tunnel used by smugglers to move contraband. Crates of illicit goods line the walls. The authorities haven't found this place yet.

moonlit_glade.name: Moonlit Glade
moonlit_glade.description: A perfectly circular clearing that seems to glow even on moonless nights. Flowers here bloom only after dark. A place of subtle magic.

thundering_falls.name: Thundering Falls
thundering_falls.description: A massive waterfall whose roar can be heard for miles. Rainbow mist fills the air. A hidden path leads behind the falls.

cursed_crossroads.name: Cursed Crossroads
cursed_crossroads.description: A crossroads where hangings once took place. The gallows tree still stands, twisted and dead. Strange things happen here at midnight.

herb_garden.name: Wild Herb Garden
herb_garden.description: A natural garden where medicinal herbs grow wild. The witch and apothecary both gather here. The plants have unusual properties.

echo_canyon.name: Echo Canyon
echo_canyon.description: A narrow canyon where sound echoes endlessly. Shout and you'll hear your voice returning for minutes. Locals tell stories here to hear them multiply.

spring_meadow.name: Eternal Spring Meadow
spring_meadow.description: A meadow where spring flowers bloom year-round. Magical in nature, it never sees winter. Butterflies dance among the flowers.

ravens_perch.name: Raven's Perch
ravens_perch.description: A dead tree where ravens gather. The birds seem unnaturally intelligent, watching travelers with knowing eyes. Locals consider them omens.

hot_springs.name: Mountain Hot Springs
hot_springs.description: Natural hot springs steam in the mountain air. The water is said to have healing properties. A popular destination despite the difficult journey.

windswept_dunes.name: Windswept Dunes
windswept_dunes.description: Tall dunes shaped by constant wind. Sand streams from their crests like smoke. The wind never stops, making travel exhausting.

cactus_garden.name: Cactus Garden
cactus_garden.description: A natural garden of cacti of all shapes and sizes. Some bloom with beautiful flowers. Water can be extracted from them in emergencies.

petrified_forest.name: Petrified Forest
petrified_forest.description: An ancient forest turned to stone. The trees stand as they did millions of years ago, now mineral instead of wood. An eerie, silent place.

glacier_edge.name: Glacier's Edge
glacier_edge.description: The edge of an ancient glacier. Blue ice stretches beyond sight. Crevasses make travel dangerous. The cold is deadly.

whale_bones.name: Whale Bones Beach
whale_bones.description: A beach where the skeleton of a massive whale lies. How it got here is a mystery. The bones create an eerie sculpture against the sea.

hermit_island.name: Hermit Island
hermit_island.description: A tiny island just offshore, accessible at low tide. A hermit lives in a hut here, seeking solitude from the world.

riverside_camp.name: Riverside Camp
riverside_camp.description: A popular camping spot by a gentle river. Fire pits and cleared ground show frequent use. A peaceful place to rest.

wild_boar_territory.name: Wild Boar Territory
wild_boar_territory.description: An area where wild boars root and forage. They're aggressive when startled. Hunters prize them but approach with caution.

old_cemetery.name: Old Cemetery
old_cemetery.description: An ancient cemetery, older than the village one. The headstones are unreadable. Some graves appear disturbed. Best not to linger.

gnome_burrow.name: Gnome Burrow
gnome_burrow.description: A hillside dotted with tiny doors and windows. If gnomes ever lived here, they're gone now. The tiny tunnels are too small for humans.

berry_patch.name: Wild Berry Patch
berry_patch.description: A patch where berries grow wild in abundance. Birds and bears compete for the harvest. Villagers come here in season.

fox_den.name: Fox Den
fox_den.description: A den where foxes raise their young. The cunning creatures watch from hiding. They're neither threatening nor friendly - just wary.

grand_harbor_road.name: Harbor Road
grand_harbor_road.description: A wide cobblestone road leads south from Port Haven toward the Grand Harbor. The smell of salt and tar grows stronger. Seagulls wheel overhead and you can hear the distant crack of sails. Merchant wagons rumble past carrying exotic goods.

grand_harbor_gate.name: Grand Harbor Gate
grand_harbor_gate.description: An impressive stone archway marks the entrance to the Grand Harbor district. Guards in blue uniforms check cargo manifests. A sign reads: 'GRAND HARBOR - Gateway to the Outer Isles'. Beyond the gate, you can see tall masts and hear the bustle of the harbor square.

grand_harbor_square.name: Grand Harbor Square
grand_harbor_square.description: The heart of the Grand Harbor district. A large fountain shaped like a kraken dominates the center. Sailors, merchants, and adventurers mingle around market stalls. The Harbor Master's office stands to the east. Docks extend in every direction, each leading to different island routes. A weathered notice board displays island information and travel costs.

harbor_master_office.name: Harbor Master's Office
harbor_master_office.description:
A sturdy building filled with maps, charts, and shipping manifests. A large world map on the wall shows the mainland surrounded by ocean, with seven islands marked at various distances:

  [Lvl 5]  Sunstone Atoll    - Tropical paradise, ancient sun temples
  [Lvl 10] Emerald Isle      - Dense rainforest, overgrown ruins
  [Lvl 15] Stormbreak Island - Thunder cliffs, shipwreck coast
  [Lvl 20] Cinderforge Island- Volcanic lands, obsidian forges
  [Lvl 25] Dreadmist Isle    - Cursed fog, undead horrors
  [Lvl 30] Wyrmscale Island  - Dragon-infested peaks
  [Lvl 40] The Abyssal Reach - Eldritch void, cosmic terrors

The Harbor Master can tell you more about each destination.

harbor_tavern.name: The Salty Compass Tavern
harbor_tavern.description: A rowdy sailor's tavern. Exotic drinks line the shelves and the walls are covered with maps, harpoons, and trophies from distant islands. Grizzled captains share tales of sea monsters and lost treasure. The barkeep serves drinks that glow faintly in the dim light.

harbor_inn_room.name: Harbor Inn Room
harbor_inn_room.description: A small but clean room above the tavern. A porthole window looks out over the harbor. The bed has a nautical-themed quilt. You can rest here before your voyage.

harbor_shop.name: Seaside Outfitters
harbor_shop.description: A well-stocked shop catering to ocean-bound adventurers. Waterproof bags, healing potions, antidotes, and sturdy rope hang from the ceiling. The shopkeeper is a retired sailor who knows what you'll need out there.

harbor_south_pier.name: South Pier
harbor_south_pier.description: A long wooden pier stretching into the deep harbor waters. Crates and barrels are stacked along its length. A shop for traveling supplies is nestled at the pier's base. From here you can see the open ocean stretching to the horizon.

harbor_watchtower.name: Harbor Watchtower
harbor_watchtower.description: A tall stone tower overlooking the entire harbor and the open ocean beyond. From this vantage point you can see the dark shapes of distant islands on the horizon. A telescope is mounted on the observation deck. Seven distinct landmasses are visible, each in a different direction.

harbor_north_dock.name: North Dock - Tropical Routes
harbor_north_dock.description:
The northern dock is painted in warm colors. Ships here are built for warm waters. Route boards advertise:

  SUNSTONE ATOLL - 'Paradise awaits! Sun, sand, and ancient mysteries.'
    Unlock: 50g | Fare: 10g | Recommended Level: 5+

  EMERALD ISLE - 'Untamed jungle. Forgotten temples. Priceless relics.'
    Unlock: 150g | Fare: 25g | Recommended Level: 10+

Type 'board sunstone' or 'board emerald' to sail.

board sunstone.transition_text:
You board a sleek tropical vessel. The crew raises colorful sails
and the ship cuts through warm turquoise waters. Schools of flying
fish leap alongside the hull. After two days at sea, golden beaches
and swaying palms emerge from the horizon...

board emerald.transition_text:
You board a sturdy exploration vessel covered in vine motifs.
The ship navigates through increasingly dense fog. Strange bird
calls echo across the water. After three days, an impossibly green
island rises from the mist, its canopy touching the clouds...

harbor_east_dock.name: East Dock - Dangerous Waters
harbor_east_dock.description:
The eastern dock is reinforced with heavy iron. The ships here are built like warships. Route boards warn:

  STORMBREAK ISLAND - 'Brace yourself. The storms never stop.'
    Unlock: 300g | Fare: 50g | Recommended Level: 15+

  CINDERFORGE ISLAND - 'Where fire meets the sea. Bring heat protection.'
    Unlock: 500g | Fare: 75g | Recommended Level: 20+

Type 'board stormbreak' or 'board cinderforge' to sail.

board stormbreak.transition_text:
You board an ironclad vessel with storm shields on every porthole.
Within hours, the sky darkens and rain lashes the deck. Lightning
forks across the heavens as the ship battles through towering waves.
After four harrowing days, jagged cliffs appear through the storm...

board cinderforge.transition_text:
You board a ship with a hull treated in fireproof lacquer.
The ocean temperature rises as you sail south. Steam vents
bubble from the sea floor. After five days, a volcanic island
glowing with rivers of lava dominates the horizon...

harbor_west_dock.name: West Dock - The Forbidden Routes
harbor_west_dock.description:
The western dock is shrouded in shadow despite the open sky. The ships here are dark-hulled, crewed by grim-faced sailors. Route boards read:

  DREADMIST ISLE - 'Turn back. The dead don't rest here.'
    Unlock: 750g | Fare: 100g | Recommended Level: 25+

  WYRMSCALE ISLAND - 'Dragons rule these skies. You've been warned.'
    Unlock: 1200g | Fare: 150g | Recommended Level: 30+

  THE ABYSSAL REACH - 'Beyond the edge of reality itself.'
    Unlock: 2000g | Fare: 250g | Recommended Level: 40+

Type 'board dreadmist', 'board wyrmscale', or 'board abyssal' to sail.

board dreadmist.transition_text:
You board a black-sailed vessel. The crew speaks in whispers.
As you sail, the fog thickens until you can barely see the bow.
Unnatural moans echo across the water. After six days of
blind navigation, a shore of pale bone-white sand appears...

board wyrmscale.transition_text:
You board a ship reinforced with dragon-scale plates. The crew
wears fireproof armor. As you approach the island, massive shadows
pass overhead — dragons circling their domain. After seven days,
scorched cliffs and the stench of sulfur welcome you...

board abyssal.transition_text:
You board a ship that seems to exist between worlds. Its hull
shimmers with void energy. Reality warps as you sail — stars
appear where sky should be, the ocean turns colors that shouldn't
exist. After an eternity (or moments?), a shore of impossible
geometry materializes from the void...

harbor_warehouse.name: Harbor Warehouse
harbor_warehouse.description: A massive warehouse storing goods from the outer islands. Crates labeled with exotic names are stacked to the ceiling. Some crates seem to glow, others are chained shut, and a few emit strange sounds. Workers move carefully around the more dangerous cargo.

harbor_customs_office.name: Customs Office
harbor_customs_office.description: A squat stone building where all incoming cargo is inspected and taxed. Clerks in ink-stained uniforms pore over manifests behind a long counter. A board on the wall lists contraband items, and a confiscation cage in the corner holds seized goods — some of which look distinctly alive.

harbor_provisions_market.name: Provisions Market
harbor_provisions_market.description: An open-air market squeezed between the tavern and the harbor square. Stalls overflow with salted meats, hardtack, barrels of fresh water, and bundles of medicinal herbs. A weathered woman selling charms claims her talismans ward off sea serpents. The smell of smoked fish is overwhelming.

harbor_sailors_barracks.name: Sailors' Barracks
harbor_sailors_barracks.description: A long, low building with rows of hammocks strung between timber posts. Off-duty sailors snore, gamble with bone dice, or mend their clothes. Personal effects dangle from hooks — lucky coins, faded letters, small carvings of loved ones. A duty roster on the wall lists upcoming voyages.

harbor_lighthouse_base.name: Harbor Lighthouse - Base
harbor_lighthouse_base.description: The base of a tall stone lighthouse that guides ships safely into port. Coils of heavy chain and spare lantern glass are stored here. A spiral staircase winds upward into the tower. The lighthouse keeper's cat watches you from atop a barrel, its eyes reflecting the distant sea.

harbor_lighthouse_top.name: Harbor Lighthouse - Lantern Room
harbor_lighthouse_top.description: The top of the lighthouse. An enormous crystal lens focuses the flame of a magical ever-burning lantern, sending a beam of light far across the ocean. The view is breathtaking — you can see every dock, every ship, and on clear days, the faint smudge of distant islands. Wind howls through the iron railing circling the narrow observation deck.

harbor_dry_dock.name: Dry Dock
harbor_dry_dock.description: A massive stone basin where ships are hauled out of the water for repairs. A half-dismantled brigantine sits on wooden supports, its hull crawling with shipwrights scraping barnacles and replacing planks. The air is thick with the smell of tar and fresh-cut timber. A crane looms overhead.

harbor_tavern_cellar.name: Tavern Cellar
harbor_tavern_cellar.description: A damp stone cellar beneath the Salty Compass. Barrels of rum, wine, and strange glowing spirits line the walls. A trapdoor that apparently once connected to smuggling tunnels has been nailed shut — mostly. Rats skitter in the shadows, and you notice scratch marks on one of the barrels that look almost like a coded message.

harbor_supply_depot.name: Harbor Supply Depot
harbor_supply_depot.description: A heavily guarded storage facility behind the Seaside Outfitters shop. Sturdy crates stamped with naval insignia contain emergency provisions for the harbor fleet. Racks hold coiled rope, folded canvas, signal flags, and casks of pitch. A quartermaster checks inventory with methodical precision.

merchant_wharf_entrance.name: Merchant's Wharf - Entrance
merchant_wharf_entrance.description: A newer section of the harbor, built on reclaimed land east of the master's office. An ornate wooden arch carved with leaping dolphins marks the entrance. The wharf is alive with commerce — foreign merchants in colorful garb haggle over prices while dock workers haul exotic cargo.

wharf_market_row.name: Wharf Market Row
wharf_market_row.description: A bustling lane of permanent market stalls built from reclaimed ship timber. Each stall bears flags from distant lands. Merchants sell silks dyed in impossible colors, spices that tingle on the tongue, and trinkets that hum with faint enchantment. A juggler entertains a crowd while a pickpocket works the audience.

wharf_auction_house.name: Wharf Auction House
wharf_auction_house.description: A large open-sided pavilion where rare goods from the outer islands go under the hammer. Rows of benches face a raised platform where an auctioneer with a booming voice displays lots — a dragon scale here, a vial of moonwater there. Wealthy merchants bid with subtle hand signals. The tension in the room is palpable.

wharf_foreign_quarters.name: Foreign Traders' Quarter
wharf_foreign_quarters.description: A cluster of colorful tents and semi-permanent structures where traders from the outer islands maintain a presence on the mainland. Each tent is decorated in the style of its home island — tropical flowers for Sunstone, living vines for Emerald, flickering embers for Cinderforge. The air is a heady mix of incense, cooking fires, and unfamiliar perfumes.

wharf_cartographer.name: The Cartographer's Study
wharf_cartographer.description: A cramped but fascinating shop belonging to a retired explorer who now makes maps. Every surface is covered with charts — ocean currents, wind patterns, island topographies, and a few maps marked 'HERE BE DRAGONS' in red ink. The cartographer peers at you through a jeweler's loupe, her fingers permanently stained with ink.

wharf_lookout_tower.name: Merchant's Lookout Tower
wharf_lookout_tower.description: A tall wooden tower at the eastern edge of the Merchant's Wharf, built so traders can spot incoming ships before their competitors. Flags snap in the wind at the top. A large brass telescope is bolted to the railing. From here you can see ships approaching from every direction, and on the clearest days, the volcanic glow of Cinderforge on the horizon.

wharf_loading_bay.name: Wharf Loading Bay
wharf_loading_bay.description: A wide stone platform at the water's edge where cargo is loaded and unloaded from merchant vessels. A massive wooden crane swings crates from ship decks onto waiting wagons. Dock workers shout instructions over the creak of ropes and splash of waves. Seagulls dive for scraps from burst crates of provisions.

wharf_cargo_yard.name: Cargo Yard
wharf_cargo_yard.description: An open yard behind the loading bay, stacked with crates, barrels, and mysterious packages awaiting collection. Each item bears tags in different languages. Guard dogs patrol between the rows. A manifest board lists expected shipments — some entries are crossed out and marked 'LOST AT SEA' in somber ink.

sunstone_docks.name: Sunstone Atoll - Harbor
sunstone_docks.description: A weathered wooden dock extends into crystal-clear turquoise water. Palm trees sway in the warm breeze. The harbor is small but well-maintained, with a few fishing boats and the larger vessel that brought you here. A sandy path leads inland toward the village.

board mainland.transition_text:
You board the return vessel. The tropical island shrinks behind
you as the ship sets course for the mainland. After a peaceful
voyage, the familiar Grand Harbor comes into view...

sunstone_dock_market.name: Dockside Market
sunstone_dock_market.description: A small open-air market near the docks. Local fishermen sell fresh catch and traders offer tropical goods. Colorful awnings provide shade from the relentless sun. The aroma of grilled fish and exotic spices fills the air.

sunstone_dock_storage.name: Dock Storage Shed
sunstone_dock_storage.description: A small thatched-roof storage shed near the pier. Fishing nets, crab traps, and diving equipment are stored here. A sunbleached map on the wall shows the atoll's layout.

sunstone_village_west.name: Sunstone Village - West
sunstone_village_west.description: The western edge of Sunstone Village. Thatched-roof huts sit on stilts above the sandy ground. Village children play with carved wooden toys. A gentle drumbeat echoes from the village center.

sunstone_village_center.name: Sunstone Village - Center
sunstone_village_center.description: The heart of Sunstone Village. A large bonfire pit surrounded by carved stone seats serves as the gathering place. An enormous sun-shaped totem stands in the center, its golden surface gleaming. Villagers go about their daily lives with quiet contentment.

sunstone_village_east.name: Sunstone Village - East
sunstone_village_east.description: The eastern part of the village. A trading post sells equipment to adventurers. Dried fish and tropical fruit hang from wooden racks. A path leads east into the jungle interior.

sunstone_village_south.name: Sunstone Village - South Path
sunstone_village_south.description: A sandy path leading south from the village toward the beaches. Torches line the path, their flames dancing in the ocean breeze. You can hear waves crashing on the shore ahead.

sunstone_inn.name: The Golden Shell Inn
sunstone_inn.description: A cozy thatched building with hammocks instead of beds. Shell windchimes tinkle in the breeze. The innkeeper serves fresh coconut water and grilled tropical fruit. A parrot on a perch squawks about treasure.

sunstone_village_shrine.name: Sun Shrine
sunstone_village_shrine.description: A small open-air shrine dedicated to the Sun God. Golden offerings gleam on a stone altar. The villagers come here at dawn and dusk to pray. Warm light seems to radiate from the shrine itself, even at night.

sunstone_village_training.name: Training Grounds
sunstone_village_training.description: An open sandy area where village warriors practice their combat skills. Wooden dummies carved to look like monsters are set up as targets. A grizzled warrior offers to spar with travelers.

sunstone_herbalist_hut.name: Herbalist's Hut
sunstone_herbalist_hut.description: A small hut overflowing with dried herbs, flowers, and strange roots. Glass bottles of colorful potions line makeshift shelves. The herbalist, an old woman with sun-darkened skin, knows remedies for everything.

sunstone_fishermans_wharf.name: Fisherman's Wharf
sunstone_fishermans_wharf.description: A small wharf where the village fishermen mend nets and clean their catch. Pelicans perch on the wooden posts, eyeing the fish buckets. An old fisherman tells tales of giant sea creatures lurking in the deep waters.

sunstone_craft_hut.name: Craftsman's Workshop
sunstone_craft_hut.description: A workshop where islanders craft items from shells, coral, and driftwood. Beautiful jewelry and weapons made from natural materials are displayed. The craftsman can work with materials you bring from the island.

sunstone_palm_grove.name: Palm Grove
sunstone_palm_grove.description: A grove of towering coconut palms. Their fronds create dappled shade on the sandy ground. Coconuts litter the ground and crabs scuttle between the roots. A warm breeze rustles through the leaves.

sunstone_palm_trail.name: Palm Trail
sunstone_palm_trail.description: A winding trail through dense palm trees. Tropical birds flit between branches, their feathers brilliant shades of red, blue, and gold. The trail slopes gently downward toward the beach.

sunstone_palm_beach_north.name: Palm Beach - North
sunstone_palm_beach_north.description: Golden sand stretches in both directions. The water is impossibly clear — you can see colorful fish swimming near the shore. Palm trees lean out over the water as if reaching for the sea. Hermit crabs leave tiny tracks.

sunstone_palm_beach_west.name: Palm Beach - West
sunstone_palm_beach_west.description: The western stretch of Palm Beach. Rocky outcrops jut from the sand, creating tide pools teeming with small sea creatures. Driftwood logs provide natural seating. A faint path leads to hidden coves further west.

sunstone_palm_beach_east.name: Palm Beach - East
sunstone_palm_beach_east.description: The eastern end of Palm Beach curves toward a sparkling lagoon. The water here changes from turquoise to deep blue where the reef drops off. Colorful coral is visible just below the surface.

sunstone_palm_beach_center.name: Palm Beach - Center
sunstone_palm_beach_center.description: The widest stretch of Palm Beach. The sand is fine and almost white. A large flat rock in the surf serves as a natural diving platform. Something glints beneath the shallow water nearby.

sunstone_beach_south.name: Southern Shore
sunstone_beach_south.description: A quiet stretch of beach south of the docks. Waves lap gently at the shore. Fishing boats are beached on the sand. An abandoned campfire surrounded by footprints suggests others have rested here recently.

sunstone_rocky_shore.name: Rocky Shore
sunstone_rocky_shore.description: The beach gives way to jagged volcanic rock. Tide pools filled with anemones, sea urchins, and small octopi dot the surface. Waves crash dramatically against the rocks, sending spray high into the air.

sunstone_coral_beach.name: Coral Beach
sunstone_coral_beach.description: A beach made entirely of crushed coral, giving it a pink-white hue. The water here is phenomenally clear. Tropical fish school in the shallows and you can see the reef structure extending far out to sea.

sunstone_beach_far_south.name: Far Southern Beach
sunstone_beach_far_south.description: The southernmost point of the atoll's beaches. Wild and untouched, with tangled seaweed and shells washing up in heaps. A weathered stone statue half-buried in sand points toward the temple ruins inland.

sunstone_tide_pools.name: Tide Pool Flats
sunstone_tide_pools.description: A wide flat area of volcanic rock exposed at low tide. Dozens of tide pools teem with small crabs, colorful fish, and swaying anemones. It's a naturalist's paradise. Be careful — the rocks are slippery.

sunstone_sea_cave_entrance.name: Sea Cave Entrance
sunstone_sea_cave_entrance.description: A dark cave mouth opens in the rocky cliff face. Waves surge in and out of the opening. The cave walls are encrusted with barnacles and mussels. Eerie echoes comes from deep within. Something glows faintly in the dark.

sunstone_sea_cave_inner.name: Sea Cave Interior
sunstone_sea_cave_inner.description: The cave opens into a surprisingly spacious grotto. Bioluminescent algae coats the walls, casting an ethereal blue glow. The floor is covered in smooth pebbles and shallow tidal water. Treasure might be hidden here.

sunstone_sea_cave_deep.name: Deep Sea Grotto
sunstone_sea_cave_deep.description: The deepest part of the sea cave. A pool of perfectly still water reflects the bioluminescent ceiling like a mirror. Ancient carvings on the walls depict the Sun God descending into the ocean. A chest sits on a ledge above the waterline.

sunstone_lagoon_path.name: Lagoon Path
